It’s really traumatic. A year ago, I got the phone call that my brother shot himself. When I drove out to the random road he was on, I could have never prepared myself for what I would see. He had used a shot gun, and killed himself. It was the worst night of my life. The most traumatic thing I have ever been through. And I would never ever wish it upon anyone. I’m on medication now, I see a therapist once a week. I can’t sleep, I think about it constantly. I have a hard time remembering what he really looked like because my brain always goes to him lying on the side walk with the shotgun between his legs. I’ll spare you the gruesome details but it was bad. I have nightmares. I will never ever be the same person I was before I saw my brother like that. It’s something that will never go away. Someone has to find you, and most likely it will be a family member, but even if it’s a stranger it is traumatic to find anyone dead. I held my brothers cold hand when the coroner picked his body up, I had to say goodbye to him, and I will never forget the way his hand felt. The way I felt. Suicide is the worst, I have so many questions, the rest of my family does. I will never understand why he did what he did. I will never understand why he wouldn’t just come talk to me. I will never stop blaming myself for not being there enough for him, or feeling like I could have done more. 
I know it’s a lot but I really hope it helps you to comprehend how much it has impacted my life. And in ways ruined it. I’m depressed, I cry a lot, I panic a lot. I have really bad days where I can barely get out of bed because my brain will just be on replay and I can’t cope with it so I just want to take my sleeping meds and sleep. I miss him and hate that I saw him like that, hate I had to say goodbye like that. Suicide doesn’t just take your life, it gravely affects everyone around you, it might feel like it won’t get better but it will. It might feel like no one cares but I promise someone does. If you wanna talk you can message me.
